info.name: GitHub Actions Artifacts Workflow Runs API
Github Actions List Workflow Runs for a Repository

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100).

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the results to fetch.

items.docs: Lists all workflow runs for a repository. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.
